item.title: Cured Salmon Avocado Toast - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: Meet Cured Salmon Avocado Toast: A buttery sourdough toast topped with avocado, cottage cheese, arugula, cured salmon, lemon juice and chili oil. A breakfast worth waking up for!

item.title: Tofu Meatballs for Spaghetti - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: This recipe for oven-baked tofu meatballs will make you wonder why you haven't always use tofu for meatballs. The texture is just right and know one will know.

item.title: Roasted Beet and Carrot Couscous with Chickpeas and Labneh - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: Roasted Beet and Carrot Couscous with Chickpeas and Labneh is stunning to look at and satisfying to devour. This vegetarian main dish comes together quicker than you might think, so it's doable for weeknights.

item.title: Tarot Card Readings for Clarity - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: If you need to find clarity around a situation, consider giving tarot readings a try. Using a deck of tarot cards is easier than you think and always on point and it's much cheaper than therapy.

item.title: Vieques Island & Finca Victoria - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: Never heard of Vieques Island? Not surprised. It's still a best kept secret for an off-the-beaten path beach vacation. Finca Victoria is the ideal place to stay when visiting this magical place.

item.title: Perfect Frittata Bites - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: I have finally mastered the method for perfect frittata bites. No more sad sunken egg muffins, no more spongy texture.

item.title: Baked Chicken Ricotta Meatballs - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: These baked chicken ricotta meatballs are now a guilty pleasure bordering on an addiction. Makes enough for dinner tonight with plenty leftover for your freezer.

item.title: Parmesan Orzo - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: Creamy, lemony parmesan orzo is a fast but fancy side dish that goes with just about any protein. It's indulgent, but you're worth it.

item.title: Breakfast Sausage Frittata Bites - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: Get your morning started right with Breakfast Sausage Frittata Bites. Recipe makes enough for today and tomorrow plus extras for your freezer.

item.title: Perfect Avocado Toast - Once Upon A Frittata
item.description: Perfect Avocado Toast = A slice of grilled sourdough bread topped with smashed avocado, cottage cheese and a juicy tomato. Finish with salt, lime, crushed red pepper and good olive oil. I seriously can't wait to eat this.
